newsitem.title: USA: Liuski Intl sees Q3 loss $1.5 to $1.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Liuski Intl sees Q3 loss $1.5 to $1.8 mln.

text.p: Liuski International Inc said Friday it expects to report a net loss for the three- month period ended September 30, 1996 of between $1.5 million and $1.8 million.

The company also said it expects to amend its 1996 second quarter Form 10-Q for the three months ended June 30, 1996 to reflect a net loss of between $1.6 million and $2.0 million as compared to the previously reported net income of $400,892.
The company said these losses are primarily the result of increases to receivables reserves.
The company said the expected net loss for the nine-month period ended September 30, 1996 is between $3.3 million and $3.7 million.
The company said it expects to report that sales for the third quarter of 1996 increased about 15 percent to more than $110 million from $96 million in the third quarter of 1995.

Sales of the company's higher margin Magitronic brand of personal and notebook computers increased 29 percent and now represents 21 percent of total sales up from 18.7 percent in the third quarter last year.
Liuski is a national wholesale distributor of more than 1,850 brand-name microcomputer peripherals, components and accessories with eight sales locations in the U.S., Canada, Hong Kong and Taiwan.
